author: abolimaboli
quote: GOTY, No Question.Resident Evil Requiem is an absolute masterpiece and easily my Game of the Year. This is what gaming should feel like. From the atmosphere and sound design to the gameplay, visuals, and storytelling, everything comes together **** game delivers an incredible experience that keeps you invested from beginning to end. The horror atmosphere is genuinely terrifying, the environments are beautifully crafted, and the attention to detail is outstanding. Every encounter feels intense, and the game constantly finds ways to keep you on **** balance between horror, action, exploration, and storytelling is fantastic. It respects what made Resident Evil special while still bringing something fresh to the table.Honestly, I don't have much to complain about. This is the kind of game that reminds you why you fell in love with gaming in the first place.Game of the Year. No debate. 10/10.

author: abolimaboli
quote: One of the most disappointing games I've ever played.Honestly, GTA 6 is fun, and I can't deny that the gameplay and overall experience have their moments. But holy ****, is this really what we waited all these years for?The story isn't nearly as good as I expected. It doesn't live up to the hype, and overall, it feels like Rockstar had the potential to deliver something truly unforgettable but somehow fell short.Another huge problem is the writing. Throughout the entire game, I couldn't shake the feeling that the story was written with a completely different audience in mind. The dialogue feels ridiculously childish, almost like it was written for 15-year-olds. The characters rarely feel as deep or interesting as they should, and some conversations are genuinely painful to sit **** facial expressions are another massive disappointment. They feel completely lifeless and lack the emotion you'd expect from a game of this scale. And despite all the details Rockstar put into the world, the overall atmosphere just doesn't feel alive. Something about the world feels strangely empty and artificial. I expected to feel immersed in a living, breathing world, but I never really got that feeling.I expected a groundbreaking story, unforgettable characters, mature writing, realistic facial animations, and something that would completely redefine what an open-world game could be. Instead, I got a game that's enjoyable but nowhere near as impressive as everyone made it out to **** seriously, HOW THE **** DID THIS GAME GET A 99 FROM GAME JOURNALISTS?Are we even playing the same game? Did everyone just forget how to criticize a game because it's GTA?It's not a terrible game, but considering the expectations, the hype, and the years of waiting, this is genuinely one of the biggest disappointments I've experienced.**Fun? Absolutely. A masterpiece? Not even close simply because I didn't **** enjoy it.
